description:
Program Overview

The Royal Academy of Engineering Research Fellowship supports outstanding early-career engineers to become future research leaders. For AI and Computer Science engineers, this fellowship provides up to 5 years of funding to establish an independent research program with engineering applications.

Funding & Benefits

  • Salary: £40,000 - £55,000 per year (depending on experience) for 5 years total
  • Research Expenses: £80,000 - £100,000 per year for research costs (annual allocation)
  • Total Package Value: Approximately £600,000 - £750,000 over 5 years
  • Leadership Development: Customized training program in research leadership throughout fellowship
  • Industry Engagement: Opportunities for industry collaborations and placements

Eligibility Criteria

  • Career Stage: Early-career researchers (typically within 5 years of PhD completion)
  • Nationality: Open to UK and international applicants (must be based at UK institution)
  • Research Area: Engineering applications of AI, including robotics, autonomous systems, computer vision, and cybersecurity
  • PhD Requirement: Must have completed PhD in engineering, computer science, or related field
  • Institutional Support: Must have sponsorship from a UK university

Priority Research Areas

  • AI for Engineering Design: Machine learning for optimizing engineering systems
  • Autonomous Systems: AI for robotics, drones, and self-driving vehicles
  • Computer Vision for Engineering: AI for inspection, monitoring, and quality control
  • Cybersecurity for Critical Infrastructure: AI for protecting engineering systems
  • Digital Twins: AI for creating virtual replicas of physical systems

Application Process

  1. Identify host institution and sponsor.
  2. Develop research proposal.
  3. Submit Expression of Interest (July-August 2026).
  4. Full Application Submission (September 2026).
  5. Interview process (November-December 2026).
  6. Award notification (January-February 2027).

Timeline & Deadlines

StageDate
Expression of InterestJuly-August 2026
Full Application DeadlineSeptember 2026
Interview PeriodNovember-December 2026
Award NotificationJanuary-February 2027
Fellowship StartApril-October 2027

Official Link

https://raeng.org.uk

Important Notes

  • Engineering focus with emphasis on practical applications of AI.
  • Customized leadership training to become a research leader.
  • Access to engineering companies for collaboration.
  • 5-year duration with opportunities for sabbaticals or industry placements.
  • Frame AI research as solving real-world engineering challenges.
